profiles.name: Profiles and app lock
profiles.description: Separate collections for different people or purposes, and a PIN or password that locks the window.

profiles.heading: Profiles
profiles.intro: Each profile is a separate collection with its own decks, media and settings.
profiles.unavailable: Profiles are only available in the desktop app.
profiles.switching: Opening the profile — the app restarts…
profiles.confirm_delete: Delete profile “{name}” and all its cards? This cannot be undone.

lock.heading: App lock
lock.intro: Locks the window, not the files: anyone who can use your computer account can still copy the collection.
lock.off: No lock is set for this profile.
lock.storage_secure: Only a salted Argon2id hash is kept, in the system keychain.
lock.storage_file: Only a salted Argon2id hash is kept, in the profile list file (the system keychain does not keep it across restarts here).
lock.wait: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} s.
lock.scope_note: The lock keeps out casual access to this window only: the collection is not encrypted, and the command line and the MCP server are not locked.
lock.recovery_body: This profile is locked, but its PIN/password hash is gone (for example, the system keychain entry was removed). Flashcard stays locked instead of opening without a check. You can remove the lock and then set a new one.
lock.recovery_confirm: I understand: remove this profile's lock
lock.held_body: These flashcard:// links arrived while the app was locked. They run after you unlock, unless you drop them.
lock.idle_hint: Locks the window when you have not used the app for this long.
lock.current_hint: Needed to change or remove the lock.
lock.kind_hint: A PIN is 4–12 digits; a password 6–128 characters.

validation.lock_secret: A PIN needs 4–12 digits; a password 6–128 characters.
validation.lock_idle: Choose one of the offered times.

conflict.profile_name: A profile with this name exists.
conflict.profile_active: The profile in use (and the main profile) cannot be deleted.
conflict.profiles_unavailable: Profiles are only available in the desktop app.
conflict.lock_retry: Too many wrong attempts. Wait a moment.
conflict.lock_state: The app lock is not set up for this.

io.profile: The profile list or folder could not be read or written.

provider.lock_storage: The system keychain holding the lock failed.
